integrity: Mathematical proof and independently formulated finite-case exact enumeration in CHECK.py; finite checks do not establish the universal result. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Results are exact for finite-poset incidence algebras over finite fields. Full text of the closely related Wright article could not be inspected; historical priority remains unverified.
title: Regular incidence-monoid elements and their complete generalized-inverse spectrum
